summary: Full-stack testing of FinDash CRM (Italian invoices/collections dashboard). All 19 pytest backend tests pass (auth, CRM data CRUD, drive/pec/bilanci, sync, copilot SSE streaming with GPT-5.4, cron webhook auth). Frontend E2E: admin login redirects to dashboard, 4 KPI cards render with real numbers (Totale Fatturato €1.198.328,98, Incassato €724.612,84), area chart renders, recent invoices table shows. Fatture page loads 47 invoices with working status filter and 22 mark-paid buttons (verified persistence). Drive Sync (4 import buttons functional), PEC Aruba (compose dialog present), Bilanci (6 company/year tabs), Settings and Copilot pages all reachable via sidebar. Copilot streamed a correct Italian AI reply via SSE ("Il totale fatturato è € 1.198.328,98."). Sync button POSTs successfully. Cron endpoint returns 401 without secret and accepted=true with correct Bearer secret.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render before ResponsiveContainer has size; harmless but noisy. Consider setting minHeight on container.

action_items: OPTIONAL: The review request references data-testid 'kpi-card-in-scadenza' but the actual attribute is 'kpi-card-scadenza' (see Dashboard.jsx line 62). Card renders correctly; only the testid name differs. Align if consistency with the spec is desired.
OPTIONAL: Suppress Recharts width/height warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents a fixed minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 503 lines - approaching split threshold; could extract auth/copilot/crm routers.
CORS allow_origins fallback to ['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True would be rejected by browsers; currently a real origin is set in .env so OK in this env.
seed_admin does not bump token_version when resetting admin password, so any old JWTs remain valid; low risk in prod-like use but worth noting.
